harness.label: Agent harness
harness.description: Which agent program drives this view. Options come from the agent_harnesses declarations of enabled modules.

provider.label: Model provider
provider.description: Which model/API vendor the harness talks to. Options depend on the selected harness.

model.label: Agent model
model.description: Model ID passed to the harness CLI. Claude: claude-opus-4-7 | claude-sonnet-4-6 | claude-haiku-4-5 (aliases: opus, sonnet, haiku). Codex: gpt-5.4 | gpt-5.4-mini. Pi: an EXACT catalogue id (e.g. anthropic/claude-sonnet-4.5) — Pi resolves an unmatched name by silent substring matching, so Agento fails the run on any mismatch; see docs/modules/pi.md.

provider_options/base_url.label: Provider base URL
provider_options/base_url.description: API endpoint for a self-hosted provider (e.g. http://ollama:11434/v1). Shown only for providers whose di.json declares the 'base_url' provider option; hosted providers do not use it.

mcp/servers.label: Additional MCP servers (JSON dict; merged on top of auto-injected toolbox entry)

identity/ssh_private_key.label: SSH private key (id_rsa, encrypted at rest)

identity/git_author_email.label: Git commit author email (user.email) — MUST be a verified email on the target Bitbucket account, or commits will not link to it
